items.title: UK's largest onshore wind farm to be rebuilt with fewer, larger turbines
items.description: Whitelee Windfarm has been producing electricity for about 20 years on a stretch of moorland near Eaglesham but is reaching the end of its life.

items.title: US signs landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
items.description: The US Department of Energy says the "peaceful" co-operation agreement will give US firms "great access" to the Saudi nuclear energy programme.

items.title: Watch: What we know about the US-Saudi nuclear deal
items.description: The BBC's Sarah Smith explains the implications of the landmark cooperation agreement between both countries.

items.title: US and Saudi Arabia reach historic nuclear energy deal
items.description: The deal is another sign of growing US-Saudi ties during US President Donald Trump's second term. The agreement, known as a 123 Agreement, would allow Saudi Arabia to build nuclear reactors using US technology.

items.title: Germany's growing interest in Africa: A win for both sides?
items.description: Germany is deepening its footprint across Africa, as Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul embarks on his third trip to the continent in 2026. His top-level talks will focus on security, skills development and investment.
